title: Gilded Engraving & Obsidian
text: Rule: stone and ruins stay near-monochrome matte obsidian with crisp silhouettes; only gold, danger telegraphs, and curses glow with pure pigment. Mood: high-stakes gothic auction house. Shape: chiseled facets, tall gate arches, sharp shadows. Color: charcoal monochrome + leaf gold (value) + crimson (danger).
